title: Returns Desk Rules for Unwanted Hardware Procurement Units
content:
## The rule

Unwanted Hardware Procurement units may be returned only within the order type's return window in calendar days after delivery. The window is counted in calendar days from the delivery date, that date being day 0, and a return authorized on the last day is in time. The clock starts from delivery, proven by the delivery date on the system record of the order the units came on.

A return is authorized only on the authorized contact's signed return request, for no more units than were delivered less those already returned. Units already returned are the units received back on that order's earlier returns, counted by return type.

Unwanted units must come back unopened, except where the order type accepts opened returns, in which case opened resaleable units are also accepted. Orders whose terms make them non-returnable accept no unwanted returns at all.

On receipt, unopened or accepted opened units are credited at the unit price times the units received, and a restocking fee of the order type's unopened or opened restocking percentage of that amount is charged, each rounded half up to the cent. Staging and handling fees are never credited, because neither is refundable on any order type. Units received damaged, or opened where that is not accepted, are not credited, damaged returns not being accepted, and are shipped back at the client's request.

A return authorization is credited at most once: once a return credit stands on the billing ledger for that return authorization, no second return credit is booked for it.

## Window boundaries (abstract)

| Return authorized on | 30-day window | 15-day window |
|---|---|---|
| the delivery date (day 0) | in time | in time |
| day 15 after delivery | in time | in time, the last day |
| day 16 after delivery | in time | not in time |
| day 30 after delivery | in time, the last day | not in time |
| day 31 after delivery | not in time | not in time |

## Unit limit, worked (hypothetical)

An order delivered with 10 units, of which 3 have already been received back, can have at most 7 units authorized on a new return.

## Credit and restocking, worked (hypothetical)

Three unopened units at a unit price of 333.33 come back on an order whose unopened restocking percentage is 15. The credit is 999.99. The restocking fee is 15 percent of 999.99, that is 149.9985, rounded half up to 150.00.
